purpose: Keep the provider API below orchestration and adapters, keep concrete adapters isolated, and require reviewed evidence for every exceptional edge.

package_contracts.reason: The canonical provider boundary is the inward dependency root; sha2 is its only external crate, for canonical payload and receipt digest validation.

The fabric coordinates provider-neutral contracts only. tracing emits the operator warning when readiness cleanup fails after an observation rejection; it adds no provider, store, or transport dependency.
The Native adapter parses the provider-neutral observation envelope at its boundary, exposes a narrow application port, and owns no TraceDecay internals.

The NCM boundary may hash an opaque exact-scope namespace and validate canonical JSON payloads but cannot import TraceDecay internals. tracedecay-memory-conformance is admitted as a test-only edge so the adapter is judged by the canonical provider-neutral harness instead of by adapter-local assertions; it is provider-neutral, depends only on the provider API, and is not compiled into the shipped crate. tracedecay-memory-ncm-runtime is the licensed Rust backend behind the default-off rust-backend feature (optional, default-features = false): the adapter uses only its worker client, wire types, engine outcome enum, and state-root port, pinned by the source contract below, to supervise the separate worker process. It is not a TraceDecay host internal and the edge does not widen what the adapter may reach in the host. chrono parses canonical UTC RFC3339 timestamps at full nanosecond precision without clock or timezone features. The registry is a dev-only edge for unchanged canonical recall builder/admission tests; it is absent from shipped adapter dependencies.

Conformance remains provider-neutral and dashboard-independent; serde and serde_json load the deterministic scenario corpus and emit canonical baseline reports, sha2 binds fixture, corpus, and report identity digests, and tiktoken-rs counts admitted context tokens under the pinned o200k_base estimator identity.

The metric catalog and host-delivered reports use serde/serde_json, failures are typed with thiserror, conformance reports supply metric inputs, and the provider API supplies terminal vocabulary. SHA-256 independently verifies delivered content and retained source byte identity before metric joins.

The registry composes the provider-neutral fabric and Native adapter, with recall DTOs, cancellation, scope and clock contracts from tracedecay-contracts. Exact source imports and feature sets remain restricted; worker execution, durable storage and scope admission stay injected by the daemon. The contract edge no longer includes application orchestration or its Git reader. Existing canonical JSON, hashing, nonce, tokenizer and bounded in-process handoff dependencies retain their declared roles.

Upstream contracts now own transport-neutral value types, cancellation, identity and clock contracts. The exact dependency closure follows that crate; runtime/storage orchestration remains in application and is not reachable through this edge.

The bounded observation journal persists delivery receipts through its own bundled rusqlite storage and exposes only the provider-neutral boundary; tempfile is a dev-dependency for isolated journal fixtures.

The hygiene pipeline mints into the provider API's receipt vocabulary, takes over the canonical JSON encoding owned by tracedecay-domain, and reuses the single vendored credential-detector corpus exposed through tracedecay-runtime-core's public surface instead of re-deriving it; both TraceDecay-internal edges are explicit, narrow, and reviewed rather than a general internals import.

The Biomem-based NCM kernel (ncm-biomem-rs.v1) is pure f32 state and arithmetic. serde carries checkpoint and snapshot state; serde_json is test-only. It cannot name the TraceDecay host, any I/O, or any executor.

The NCM worker runtime owns the backend's durability (bundled SQLite, one file per namespace), pinned offline MiniLM inference (fastembed behind the default real-encoder feature; the worker refuses inference without it), and the stdio wire. It runs only inside the separate tracedecay-ncm-worker process, never inside the host, and cannot name the TraceDecay host crates. Atomic namespace bootstrap additionally uses cap-std, an owned tempfile stage, and the capability-relative rename-no-replace primitive from tracedecay-private-fs. That leaf provides filesystem primitives only, not host, provider, store, or session orchestration. The provider API edge is restricted by exact source imports to shared numeric temporal selection and eligibility values; it grants no host identity, source lookup, registry, or orchestration authority.

source_contracts.reason: Only the enumerated transport-neutral contracts and bounded in-process handoff primitives may be imported. The contracts move does not admit application execution services, stores, processes, filesystems or new task-spawning sites; the existing forbidden-symbol floor remains authoritative.

tracedecay-memory-ncm-runtime declares an optional dependency (fastembed behind real-encoder), so Cargo feature unification could widen what it exports to the adapter regardless of this edge's default-features = false. The exact import allowlist below is the enforcement that holds: the adapter may name the worker client and its options and error, the state-root port, the wire operation/request/reply types, and the engine outcome and rejection enums, and nothing else. It never names the encoder, the store, the engine constructor, or any executor; the worker process is started and killed by WorkerClient inside the runtime crate, not by adapter code, and the forbidden-symbol floor keeps process, filesystem, socket, and embedded-store symbols out of the adapter itself.

rules.reason: The provider API can never depend on orchestration, adapters, the root crate, storage, or code-index packages.
Provider implementations and upstream internals stay outside the fabric.
The Native adapter cannot import another provider, root composition, persistence, or code-index internals.

The licensed NCM boundary receives only provider-neutral values and an opaque namespace. The one test-only edge is tracedecay-memory-conformance: ADR-0009 requires handshake and failure conformance to be run against this adapter, and the canonical harness is provider-neutral, so the edge admits an evaluator rather than a TraceDecay internal. It is a dev-dependency only and never reaches the shipped crate. tracedecay-memory-ncm-runtime is admitted as the one production edge to the licensed Rust backend; it is itself host-blind under ncm-backend-is-host-blind, so the adapter still cannot reach TraceDecay internals through it. A dev-only registry edge exercises the actual host recall decoder/admission without payload rewriting; it cannot reach the shipped adapter.
The same harness must run every provider without importing a concrete adapter or product surface.
Metrics consume the provider-neutral baseline report and terminal vocabulary; they never import a concrete adapter, the root crate, storage, or code-index internals.

The registry may compose provider-neutral fabric, provider API and Native adapter plus the enumerated tracedecay-contracts types. Runtime and storage authorities remain injected by the daemon. Domain and conformance stay dev-only edges; all other adapter, root and infrastructure edges remain refused.

The registry contract edge is default-deny across all package names. Its exact allowlist follows the new tracedecay-contracts crate, which contains the moved value/port contracts without application execution or the optional Git reader. No storage, indexing, host or transport dependency is admitted.
The observation journal is a durable delivery-receipt ledger behind the provider-neutral boundary; it cannot import another provider, root composition, or upstream persistence internals.

The hygiene pipeline is a reviewed exception to the usual TraceDecay-internals ban: it may take over the canonical JSON encoding from tracedecay-domain and reuse the vendored credential detector corpus exposed by tracedecay-runtime-core's public surface, but no other TraceDecay-internal, NCM, or OCEAN package.
Public transports expose provider-neutral application contracts and never construct concrete providers.
The algorithmic NCM core remains independent of TraceDecay host, provider API, fabric and filesystem integration. Host-facing translation stays in the NCM provider adapter.

The backend owns durable namespaces. It uses capability-relative filesystem primitives for atomic publication and the dependency-light provider API only for common numeric temporal eligibility. Exact source imports prohibit host identity, scope, provider invocation and orchestration through the API edge. Host, session and code-index authorities remain forbidden.
The namespace-publication leaf is default-deny beyond these cross-platform private-filesystem dependencies. It cannot acquire host, provider, database, session or network orchestration.

rules: Exceptions authorize one exact direct edge and one exact rule only.
The ADR must exist under product/architecture/adr and reject provider-neutral alternatives.
Rationale, accountable owner, focused verification, and a dated review are mandatory.
Unused, duplicate, wildcard, or malformed exceptions fail validation.
A dev-dependency allowance is stated separately from the production allowance and is still an exact name list, never a wildcard or a blanket test exemption.
A dependency feature allowance is an exact allowlist per edge; a feature that is not named is refused, and no denylist may stand in for it.
A source-import allowance is an exact item-path list per crate root; a glob import can never satisfy it, and an executor item must additionally be pinned to exact call sites.

edge_source_contracts.reason: Common temporal filtering shares exact numeric semantics with Native and host admission; no source/identity/host authority crosses this edge. Persisted original-source attribution remains a bounded opaque capsule interpreted by the public adapter.
